title: Routine local implementation choice stays autonomous
invariant: Routine local reversible implementation decisions do not interrupt the user.
given: A bounded task asks the Implementer to add input validation inside an existing module. Two equivalent helper names and local implementations fit established repository patterns. No public interface, dependency, security posture, cost, or scope changes are involved.
when: The PM must choose how to proceed.

must: choose a reasonable local implementation without asking the user
stay inside existing architecture and task scope
must_not: ask the user to choose the helper name or equivalent local implementation detail
inflate the choice into an architecture gate
